description: Blazor project and item templates with Telerik UI for Blazor and Docker integration. Configure the Telerik Blazor components via template options like CSS theme, icon type, localization, and RTL support.
releaseNotes:
NEW
* Add support for the official .NET 10.
* Add support for Telerik UI for Blazor 12.0.0.

FIXED
* Remove the ReconnectModal component from the Web App template when using WebAssembly render mode.
* Populate appsettings.json in the WebAssembly Standalone template and the Client project in the Web App template.
* Remove launchSettings.json from the Client project in the Web App template.
title: Telerik Blazor Project and Item Templates
